message.source: KEYS Space the leader card, in Normal mode: a key runs its command (its list is the card); Ctrl+Space opens it in every editor mode Ctrl+G, SPC /, SPC SPC search the workspace, by words and meaning: the hits on the left, the file on the right at the hit; beneath, a checkbox per stage it can run (Lexical; Semantic with a model in use; Rerank, naming the ranker, with one in use): a change searches again, and one of Lexical and Semantic stays checked / find a word in the pane with the keyboard (the page, the explorer, the links); n and N find it again, forward and back. In the page its words are marked, and "finding …" shows at the top right: its ✕ clears it, as Search › Clear find does. In the Text mode / types a slash: Search › Find in page, Find next, Find previous * # in the page, in Vim's Normal mode, find the word under the cursor, whole, on or back (g* g# as part of a word too): it becomes the page's find, so n and N go on SPC o open a document: a filter over the workspace's files, with a preview SPC B switch buffer (Go › Buffers…, :b): the open files and drafts, each previewed with its unsaved text; SPC C closes the one shown (File › Close buffer, :bd), asking first over unsaved changes H L in the page, in Vim's Normal mode, the buffer before or after the shown one, in the order of the GUI's tabs, wrapping (bufferline's Shift+h / Shift+l): this replaces Vim's H and L (the screen's top and bottom line) in Normal mode only; Visual mode keeps them, and Insert mode types them. A script's own H or L (autodoc.map) wins Ctrl+O Ctrl+I back and forward along the jumps (Vim's jump list, in Normal mode): a link followed, a document opened from a picker, the explorer, the links or the recent files, and the page's own jumps (G, gg, %, { }, a mark's). Back to another document opens it where you left it, in the view you left it in SPC f open a file anywhere on the disk (File › Open file…), with a preview: one in a workspace's folder opens there; any other is in no workspace, so it has no search, links, backlinks, frontmatter check or embeddings (the status line says so) SPC r the recent files, the newest first, of every workspace (File › Recent files…); one of another workspace opens there SPC d view the Mermaid diagram at the cursor (File › Preview Mermaid diagram…; the editor's right-click View diagram) SPC H preview the note as HTML (File › Preview HTML) File › Open with Default App the file in the desktop's default app: a PDF in its reader, for what its derived text cannot show Ctrl+N new file, in any folder (File › New file…; SPC n); .md added when it has none Ctrl+S save the file Ctrl+; the command line, in every editor mode (:, in Vim's Normal mode): :w, :find, :table, your Lua commands … (Search › Command line…; a terminal needs kitty's keyboard protocol to send Ctrl+;) Ctrl+W switch workspace (SPC w too); Manage… adds, renames and deletes them. In the Vim editor mode's Insert, Ctrl+W is Vim's: it deletes the word before the cursor (Esc first to switch). Insert's Ctrl+U deletes back to the indent, and Ctrl+O runs one Normal-mode command Ctrl+h/j/k/l in Normal mode, to the open panel on that side, and back to the page F6 and Shift+F6 the next or the previous open widget: the editor and the panels, never the menu bar. SPC Tab, or :go <name>, goes to one by name (Go › Widget…) F10, Alt+letter the menu bar, which hides until then (Options › Editor preferences can keep it). SPC m show and focus the menu bar; again hides it On a Mac, Option+letter is Alt+letter (US layout; Option+E, I, N, U are dead keys there), and F10 may need Fn SPC k the editor mode: Vim (modal) or Text (modeless, an ordinary text editor's keys) ? the Vim keys' card, at the bottom right (Normal mode); ? again closes it SPC h the notifications' history (Go › Notifications…) F11, SPC M maximize or restore the terminal or the agents (the one with the keyboard, in a shell too, else the newest open), as their tab menu's Maximize: a program in a panel never gets F11; a terminal emulator that takes F11 itself (GNOME Terminal's full screen) keeps it: SPC M always works F1 this help (Help › Keys); Help › Tutorial… the tutorial; Ctrl+Q quit Shift+F10, the Menu key, SPC . the page's right-click menu, at the cursor Ctrl+= Ctrl+- Ctrl+0 in the GUI's window, zoom in, out, and back to 100% (Options › Fonts and zoom… chooses the fonts too); a terminal's own settings choose its font. message.source:
THE PAGE The file is a page 120 columns wide, centred, the ruler at its edge (Preferences sets the width). In the Vim editor mode, i types and Esc goes back to Normal; in the Text mode, typing types. With no file open, the page is an untitled draft: type, and Ctrl+S names and saves it. The status line (SPC t) shows the mode, the file, and [+] while it has unsaved changes, and on its right what the page says (a find's result). The page's frame shows where the cursor is: the headings above it in Markdown, the key path in YAML. SPC O (Go › Outline…) lists the file's headings, unsaved ones too; Enter jumps there. Long lines wrap at the page's width, and line numbers can show: View › Wrap long lines, Line numbers, or Preferences. A PDF or DOCX opens as its derived text, read-only, where the daemon's build derives it: the frame and the status line say [PDF · read-only]. Motions, find, copy and the outline work; edits and saves do not. File › Open with Default App opens the original. A long one shows as much as one read carries, and says where it was cut. An HTML file asks first: Simplified, its derived text read-only as above, or Raw, the HTML itself to edit and save. In the GUI a raw file's Rendered view (Ctrl+T) is its page: j k or the arrows scroll, Ctrl+D Ctrl+U half a page, g G the ends, and its links open as notes, files or the browser. Its stylesheets and images load from its workspace (a file outside every workspace: its own folder only; add the folder as a workspace for a site sharing ../assets).
NOTIFICATIONS What happens (a save, the connection, indexing) is a notification in a corner, saying how long ago it came; up to three show, the rest wait. A finished one stays a few seconds; a task's progress stays until it ends. Preferences sets the corner and the seconds; SPC h lists them.
THE PANELS The explorer is one panel of two tabs: Explorer (SPC e), every workspace's folders and files, and Links (SPC l), what this file is connected to, by kind: superseded by, supersedes, sources, cited by, amends, amended by, related, adr, its links and its backlinks, then what names nothing and the supersession loops. d in the links shows the files two links away, under the one that reaches them. It opens over the page from its side (Preferences sets which): SPC e and SPC l open it on their tab, or go to it from the other, and on their own tab close it, as Escape does; Ctrl+PageUp and Ctrl+PageDown change tabs. At the strip's right end, _ hides it to the dock, whose icon shows it again as it was, + maximizes it (again to restore), and x closes it. Enter on a file opens it, closing the panel from the Explorer and hiding it from the Links. SPC j goes to the link under the cursor: the document it names, else its web address or file. SPC b goes back to the previous document, where you left it (Ctrl+O steps back one jump at a time, within a document too). The page's right-click menu has both, Go to link (on a link) and Back. In the GUI the pointer tells what a click does: an I-beam over text, a hand where a click follows a link (the HTML pane's links and the links' rows), arrows on an edge or divider to drag. A link in the editor is followed with SPC j or the menu, not a click, so it keeps the I-beam. The agent (SPC g, Go › Agent) runs an AI agent's CLI over the page, from the top unless Preferences sets another edge or the centre: the default of System › Agent profiles… (SPC G), each profile a name and the command that starts it (claude, codex…). It starts in AutoDoc's own folder for the workspace, told about the workspace in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md there, and keeps running while hidden. Each agent has a tab, named by its codename: + on the strip offers the profiles (a running one goes to its tab, a stopped one starts), and a tab's menu (≡, a right click anywhere on the strip or on an empty panel, or Enter on the strip) has Go to ›, Restart, Close (asked first while the agent runs), Profiles…, Theme and font…, Maximize (Restore while it fills the dock area) and Hide, which closes the panel and leaves every agent running; Use in the profiles starts another too. The strip's _, + and x, at its right end, hide the panel, maximize it (again to restore), or stop every agent and close it, asked once while any runs. SPC a b (:agent-buffer) pastes the page into an agent's prompt, and SPC a f (:agent-forward) the selection, else the clipboard: to the agent running, or one chosen; SPC a is the agents' card, g and G on it the panel and the profiles. No Enter is added: an agent CLI that takes bracketed paste holds it all at its prompt; elsewhere each line break is Enter. The terminal (SPC `, Go › Terminal) runs your shells in the workspace's folder, at the bottom or wherever Preferences puts it (top, left, right, or centred), each place with its own size. A shell starts when it opens with none, and keeps running while hidden. Each shell has a tab: + adds one, and a tab's menu has Go to ›, New, Close, Theme and font…, Maximize (Restore) and Hide (the panel closed, every shell running on). The strip's _ does the same, + maximizes it (again to restore), and x stops every shell and closes the panel, asked once while any runs. Theme and font… (Preferences' terminal row and Options › Fonts and zoom… too) sets the terminals' theme, their text, background and cursor only, a program's own colours staying its own, and in a window their font; Esc in it puts back what was there. Every key goes to the shell, Esc too; Ctrl+T (or Ctrl+\ Ctrl+n) leaves for Normal mode, where h j k l, w b e, gg G, Ctrl+u/d/b/f, / and ? move over its history, v or V selects and y copies, and Ctrl+T, i or Enter goes back. The agent panel's keys are the same. Escape in Normal mode, or SPC ` again, hides it; the keyboard goes back where it was. When a shell exits (exit, Ctrl+D) its tab closes, a failing exit kept as a notice; the last one's exit closes the pane, and the next SPC ` starts another. Every panel moves and resizes. Alt (Option on a Mac) with the left button drags it anywhere, with the right button resizes it; SPC L (Go › Arrange panel…) does both by keys: h j k l or the arrows move it, H J K L or Shift with them resize it, Enter keeps it, Esc puts it back. It opens where it was left from then on. Go › Reset panel layout docks every panel at its edge again, as a new edge in Preferences does for one. A terminal may keep Alt+click for itself; the keys always work.
WHAT A KEY NEEDS Everything here needs the daemon (autodoc --serve). --ui starts it when nothing answers; if it does not come up, Help › About names its log. Ctrl+S writes only over the version you opened. If the file changed on disk since, it asks: keep editing, reload the disk's version (u brings your text back), or overwrite it with yours. Open files follow the disk: a file changed elsewhere reloads in place when it has no unsaved changes (one undo step), and is marked "changed on disk" ([!]) and asked about when you next open or save it when it has; a file deleted on disk keeps its text, and a save creates it again. Preferences › files changed on disk can ask first for clean files too. A path must be one the workspace indexes (new workspaces include Markdown, text and YAML); others are refused. Semantic search needs an embedding provider, chosen in System › Search models (SPC s): a local Ollama with an embedding model, Ollama Cloud, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Without one, search is by words, and the hits say "semantic off". The status line's mark names the model searching, and a change of model clears the search, its words and hits, to start afresh. File › Preview Mermaid diagram and Preview HTML show an image in the terminal only with all of: View › Image previews on; a terminal that confirmed kitty graphics (inside tmux, set -g allow-passthrough on); and a headless Chromium or Chrome. The image scrolls (arrows, j k h l, PgUp/PgDn, [ ], Home/End, the wheel) and Zoom in / Zoom out redraw it. Otherwise a diagram shows its source and HTML opens in the browser, and the preview says which was missing. View › Image previews off compares the two on the same file. Under --gui, Preview HTML opens a pane beside the editor instead: the note's page drawn natively, live as you type, following the cursor, its text selectable, its links opening notes, files and the browser. Under --gui, File › Preview option chooses what draws Mermaid diagrams, in Preview Mermaid diagram and the pane: Mermaid.js (the default; a headless browser, a few seconds a diagram, with zoom) or the Native Mermaid engine (golib's, at once, no zoom; a type it does not draw is still mermaid.js's). field:value in a search (type:adr) filters by a frontmatter field, and the line over the page names a file's frontmatter problems, only once the workspace has a schema: Manage… › Edit… names the file (suggested: .autodoc/schema.yaml). Without one, field:value is searched as words. Adding a workspace needs a directory: Markdown, text and YAML are indexed, .git skipped. A name or root another workspace has is refused. Deleting one removes its index only; its files stay. A workspace marked error has a root that is gone: bring the directory back and restart the daemon, or delete the workspace. autodoc --ui <name> opens that workspace; without a name, the one used last. Opening, switching or quitting over unsaved changes asks first: Save, Discard or Stay.

页面 文件显示为 120 列宽的页面，居中，标尺位于其边缘(宽度在首选项中 设置)。在 Vim 编辑器模式下，按 i 输入，按 Esc 返回 Normal；在 Text 模式下，直接输入 即可。未打开文件时，页面是一份无标题 草稿：输入内容后按 Ctrl+S 命名并保存。状态栏(SPC t)显示模式、文件， 有未保存的更改时显示 [+]，右侧显示页面的提示信息(如查找结果)。 页面边框显示光标所在位置：Markdown 中为其上方的各级标题，YAML 中为 键路径。SPC O(转到 › 大纲…)列出文件的标题，包括未保存的；按 Enter 跳转。 长行按页面宽度换行，也可显示行号：视图 › 长行自动换行、行 号，或首选项。 PDF 或 DOCX 以其派生文本只读打开(需守护进程的版本支持派生)： 边框和状态栏显示 [PDF · read-only]。移动、查找、复制和大纲可用； 编辑和保存不可用。“文件 › 用默认应用打开”可打开原文件。较长的文件只显示单次读取 所能承载的内容，并注明截断位置。 HTML 文件会先询问：简化(如上，派生文本只读)或原始(直接 编辑并保存 HTML)。在 GUI 中，原始文件的渲染视图(Ctrl+T)即其页面：j k 或 方向键滚动，Ctrl+D Ctrl+U 滚动半页，g G 到首尾，其链接可作为笔记、 文件或在浏览器中打开。其样式表和图片从所在工作区加载(不属于任何工作区 的文件：仅限其所在文件夹；若站点共享 ../assets，请将该文件夹添加为工作区)。
通知 发生的事件(保存、连接、索引)以通知形式显示在角落，并注明发生在多久 之前；最多同时显示三条，其余排队。已完成的通知停留几秒；任务的 进度通知会一直显示到任务结束。首选项可设置角落位置和秒数；SPC h 列出所有通知。
面板 资源管理器是一个有两个标签页的面板：资源管理器(SPC e)显示所有工作区的文件夹和文件；链接(SPC l) 按类型列出此文件关联的内容：被取代于、取代、来源、被引用于、修订、被修订于、相关、adr、其链接和 反向链接，以及未指向任何内容的链接和取代循环。在链接中按 d 可显示两跳之外的文件，列在通往它们的 那个文件下。面板从其所在一侧覆盖在页面上打开(在首选项中设置)：SPC e 和 SPC l 在各自的标签页打开它， 或从另一个标签页切换过去，在自己的标签页上则像 Escape 一样关闭它；Ctrl+PageUp 和 Ctrl+PageDown 切换标签页。标签栏右端的 _ 将其隐藏到停靠栏，图标可按原样再显示它，+ 将其最大化(再按一次还原)，x 则关闭它。在文件上按 Enter 打开它：从资源管理器会关闭面板，从链接则隐藏面板。 SPC j 转到光标下的链接：其指向的文档，否则为其网址或文件。 SPC b 返回上一个文档，回到你离开时的位置(Ctrl+O 每次后退一次 跳转，文档内也适用)。页面的右键菜单两者都有：转到链接(在链接上) 和后退。 在 GUI 中，指针表示点击会做什么：在文本上是 I 形光标，在点击会跟随链接的地方(HTML 窗格的 链接和链接面板的行)是手形，在可拖动调整大小的边缘和分隔线上是箭头。编辑器中的链接通过 SPC j 或菜单跟随，而不是点击，因此仍是 I 形光标。 智能体面板(SPC g，转到 › 智能体)在页面上运行 AI 智能体的 CLI，默认从顶部打开，除非 首选项设置为其他边缘或居中：使用“系统 › 智能体配置…”(SPC G)中的默认配置， 每个配置包含名称和启动命令(claude、codex…)。 它在 AutoDoc 为该工作区准备的专用文件夹中启动，通过其中的 AGENTS.md 和 CLAUDE.md 了解工作区，隐藏时仍保持运行。每个智能体有一个以其代号命名的标签页： 标签栏上的 + 列出各配置(已运行的会切换到其标签页，已停止的会启动)， 标签页菜单(≡，在标签栏或空面板上任意处右键，或在 标签栏上按 Enter)包含 转到 ›、重启、关闭(智能体运行时会先询问)、配置…、主题与 字体…、最大化(占满停靠区时为“还原”)和隐藏(关闭面板， 所有智能体继续运行)；在配置中点“使用” 也可再启动一个。 标签栏右端的 _ 隐藏面板，+ 将其最大化(再按一次还原)，x 停止所有智能体并关闭面板(有运行中的智能体时只询问一次)。 SPC a b(:agent-buffer)将页面粘贴到智能体的提示符中，SPC a f(:agent-forward) 粘贴所选内容，否则粘贴剪贴板：发送给正在运行的智能体，或所选的智能体；SPC a 打开智能体 卡片，卡片上的 g 和 G 分别打开面板和配置。不会自动添加 Enter：支持 括号粘贴的智能体 CLI 会把内容全部留在提示符中；否则每个换行都相当于 Enter。 终端(SPC `，转到 › 终端)在工作区文件夹中运行你的 shell，默认在底部， 或在首选项指定的位置(顶部、左侧、右侧或居中)，每个位置各有其大小。 打开时若没有 shell 则启动一个，隐藏时仍保持运行。每个 shell 有一个标签页： + 添加一个，标签页菜单包含 转到 ›、新建、关闭、主题与字体…、最大化(还原) 和隐藏(关闭面板，所有 shell 继续运行)。标签栏右端的 _ 同样隐藏，+ 将其最大化(再按一次还原)，x 停止 所有 shell 并关闭面板(有运行中的 shell 时只询问一次)。主题与字体…(也可通过首选项的终端一行及“选项 › 字体 与缩放…”)设置终端的主题，仅限文字、背景和光标，程序自身的 颜色保持不变，在窗口中还可设置字体；在其中按 Esc 恢复原样。所有按键都发送给 shell，包括 Esc;Ctrl+T(或 Ctrl+\ Ctrl+n)进入 Normal 模式，在其中 h j k l、w b e、gg G、 Ctrl+u/d/b/f、/ 和 ? 在历史中移动，v 或 V 选择，y 复制，Ctrl+T、i 或 Enter 返回。智能体面板的按键相同。 在 Normal 模式下按 Escape，或再按 SPC `，即可隐藏它；键盘焦点回到原处。 shell 退出时(exit、Ctrl+D)其标签页关闭，异常退出会保留为通知；最后一个 shell 退出时关闭窗格，下次按 SPC ` 会启动新的 shell。 所有面板均可移动和调整大小。按住 Alt(Mac 上为 Option)用左键可拖到任意位置， 用右键可调整大小；SPC L(转到 › 排列面板…)用按键完成两者：h j k l 或 方向键移动，H J K L 或 Shift+方向键调整大小，Enter 保留，Esc 还原。之后它 会在上次的位置打开。“转到 › 重置面板布局”会将所有面板重新停靠到各自 边缘，就像在首选项中为某个面板设置新边缘一样。终端可能会自己占用 Alt+单击； 按键方式始终可用。
按键的前提条件 这里的一切都需要守护进程(autodoc --serve)。没有响应时 --ui 会启动它；若 未能启动，“帮助 › 关于”会给出其日志位置。 Ctrl+S 只会覆盖你打开时的版本。若此后文件在磁盘上有更改，会询问： 继续编辑、重新加载磁盘版本(按 u 可恢复你的文本)，或用你的版本覆盖。 打开的文件跟随磁盘：在别处更改的文件若无未保存的更改，会就地重新加载 (一步撤销)；若有，则标记为“changed on disk”([!])，并在你下次 打开或保存时询问；在磁盘上被删除的文件会保留其文本，保存会重新创建它。 首选项 › 磁盘上已更改的文件 也可设置为对无改动的文件先询问。 路径必须是工作区索引的(新工作区包括 Markdown、文本和 YAML)；其他路径 会被拒绝。 语义搜索需要嵌入提供方，在“系统 › 搜索模型”(SPC s)中选择：带嵌入模型的本地 Ollama、 Ollama Cloud，或兼容 OpenAI 的端点。没有提供方时按 词语搜索，结果中会显示“semantic off”。状态栏的标记显示正在搜索的模型， 更换模型会清除搜索(其词语和结果)，重新开始。 “文件 › 预览 Mermaid 图表”和“预览 HTML”只有同时满足以下条件时才在终端中显示图像： “视图 › 图片预览”已开启；终端已确认支持 kitty 图形协议(在 tmux 中需 set -g allow-passthrough on)；并有无头 Chromium 或 Chrome。图像可滚动(方向键、j k h l、 PgUp/PgDn、[ ]、Home/End、滚轮)，放大 / 缩小会重新绘制。否则图表 显示其源码，HTML 在浏览器中打开，预览会说明缺少哪一项。 关闭“视图 › 图片预览”可在同一文件上对比两者。 在 --gui 下，“预览 HTML”改为在编辑器旁打开一个窗格：原生绘制笔记页面， 随输入实时更新并跟随光标，文本可选择，链接可打开 笔记、文件和浏览器。 在 --gui 下，“文件 › 预览选项”选择由什么绘制 Mermaid 图表(用于“预览 Mermaid 图表”和该窗格)：Mermaid.js(默认；使用无头浏览器，每个图表需几秒，支持 缩放)或原生 Mermaid 引擎(golib 的，即时绘制，不支持缩放；它不支持的图表类型仍由 mermaid.js 绘制)。 搜索中的 field:value(如 type:adr)按 frontmatter 字段筛选，页面上方的提示行 会指出文件的 frontmatter 问题，前提是工作区已配置架构：在“管理… › 编辑…”中 指定该文件(建议：.autodoc/schema.yaml)。没有架构时，field:value 按普通词语搜索。 添加工作区需要一个目录：索引 Markdown、文本和 YAML，跳过 .git。与其他工作区 名称或根目录相同的会被拒绝。删除工作区只移除其索引；文件保留。 标记为错误的工作区，其根目录已不存在：恢复该目录并重启 守护进程，或删除该工作区。 autodoc --ui <name> 打开该工作区；不带名称时打开上次使用的工作区。 在有未保存的更改时打开、切换或退出，会先询问：保存、丢弃或留下。
